title: Draftsman (Highway / Structural)
details: Preparation and modification of highway and structural drawings
Preparation of plan, profile, cross-section and detail drawings
Preparation of road, drainage, culvert and structure drawings
Preparation of structural detailing and reinforcement drawings
Drafting from survey data, engineering sketches and design inputs
Preparation of quantity drawings and drawings for BOQ support
Updating drawings based on site measurements and engineering revisions
Maintaining drawing standards, layers, dimensions, annotations and sheet layouts
Drawing coordination with Engineers and Project Teams
Preparation of drawings for DPR, tender and construction documentation
software: AutoCAD | Civil 3D | OpenRoads | MS Excel | GIS/QGIS | Other CAD / Drafting tools
qualification: Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech in Civil Engineering or related disciplines.
description: Candidates with good AutoCAD drafting skills and knowledge of highway / structural drawings are encouraged to apply. Fresh graduates with strong CAD skills may also apply.
